blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Imaginary ailments are incurable.
exercises.why: **воображать → Воображаемые** — present passive participle: first person plural + adjective ending (-емый / -имый).

exercises.prompt: Tom had scratches on his face.
exercises.why: **исцарапать → исцарапано** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-; the short form drops one н.

exercises.prompt: What Tom saw made him nervous.
exercises.why: **увидеть → Увиденное** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-.

exercises.prompt: Is the product in the ad already out of stock?
exercises.why: **рекламировать → Рекламируемый** — present passive participle: first person plural + adjective ending (-емый / -имый).

exercises.prompt: Security of the perimeter was also ramped up drastically.
exercises.why: **увеличить → увеличена** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-; the short form drops one н.

exercises.q: Выдыхая в холодную погоду, можно видеть свой ___ (выдохнуть) воздух.
exercises.prompt: When you breathe out in cold weather, you can see your breath.
exercises.why: **выдохнуть → выдохнутый** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-.

exercises.prompt: The suspect was read his rights.
exercises.why: **подозревать → Подозреваемому** — present passive participle: first person plural + adjective ending (-емый / -имый).

exercises.prompt: It'll be finished in a day or two.
exercises.why: **закончить → закончен** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-; the short form drops one н.

exercises.q: ___ (упомянуть) вами имён в списке нигде не значится.
exercises.prompt: The names you've mentioned aren't anywhere to be found in the list.
exercises.why: **упомянуть → Упомянутых** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-.

exercises.q: В немецком языке есть глаголы с ___ (отделять) приставками.
exercises.prompt: German has separable verbs.
exercises.why: **отделять → отделяемыми** — present passive participle: first person plural + adjective ending (-емый / -имый).

exercises.prompt: Alaska is situated northwest of Canada.
exercises.why: **расположить → расположена** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-; the short form drops one н.

exercises.prompt: Your reading is very advanced.
exercises.why: **продвинуть → продвинутое** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-.

exercises.prompt: Love is a temporary insanity curable by marriage.
exercises.why: **излечивать → излечиваемое** — present passive participle: first person plural + adjective ending (-емый / -имый).

exercises.q: Когда в России было ___ (отменить) крепостное право?
exercises.prompt: When was serfdom abolished in Russia?
exercises.why: **отменить → отменено** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-; the short form drops one н.

exercises.prompt: Which is the most populated continent in the world?
exercises.why: **населить → населённый** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-.

exercises.prompt: The defendant was granted an appeal.
exercises.why: **обвинять → Обвиняемому** — present passive participle: first person plural + adjective ending (-емый / -имый).

exercises.prompt: A ballistic examination was carried out.
exercises.why: **провести → проведена** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-; the short form drops one н.

exercises.prompt: A penny saved is a penny earned.
exercises.why: **сберечь → сбереженное** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-.

exercises.q: В ячейке есть система обработки ___ (хранить) информации.
exercises.prompt: The cell has a system for processing stored information.
exercises.why: **хранить → хранимой** — present passive participle: first person plural + adjective ending (-емый / -имый).

exercises.prompt: Mary is in love with the boy with blond hair.
exercises.why: **влюбить → влюблена** — past passive participle: from a perfective verb, with -нн-, -енн- or -т-; the short form drops one н.
